description: This source file defines the ReadableOrderProduct class, which extends OrderProductEntity and implements Serializable. It contains fields such as productName, price, subTotal, sku, and image, along with their respective getter and setter methods. The class appears to serve as a data transfer object for order products with readable attributes.
